attemptRecord.description: One written record per capture attempt, both lanes. Scripted bonds in the show are declared, never rolled, and carry status 'scripted'.

areaId.description: Spawn-table area id (#7) where the meeting happened.

checksPassed.description: How many staged checks passed before the outcome resolved — the legibility data. Must be <= the system's CHECK_COUNT once set.

instrumentTier.description: tierId of the instrument used, or null when the bond was not instrument-mediated (e.g. the canon first bond: a rescue-choosing, given not taken).

status.description: 'rolled' for game-resolved attempts, 'scripted' for show-declared bonds, 'canon: <source>' where a record restates canon.

statusAtAttempt.description: Target's status condition id, or null (neutral factor until the status system lands).

storyBeat.description: Event-flag id (#12) arming the attempt, or null for free encounters.

instrumentTier.description: One tier of keeper instrument. The list ships EMPTY: canon has named no capture instruments. Entries are added only by owner canon, never by tooling.

multiplier.description: Tier multiplier in the capture roll. OPEN value — set only with the tier's canon entry.

description: Mochiichao capture system records (#38). Two shapes: an instrument-tier list entry and a capture-attempt audit record. All tuning constants are OPEN until the owner sets them; a species with catchRate null in core data is not capturable in data, never defaulted.
title: Mochiichao capture records
